data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements berht (bright, shining) and ton (tune, thunder). This name was brought to England by the Normans and was borne by various early Christian saints. It is a strong and noble name, evoking images of bravery and leadership. The name Berton carries the meaning “Bright, shining, bold” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berton usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining, bold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
